artifact.locator: the measurement block on this record. Full per-trade detail was computed inline on the trainer VM during a manual trainer-vm-diag command and printed to the issue comment (https://github.com/benbaichmankass/Metis-Insights/issues/13045#issuecomment-5853115601) -- MEASURED (source not durably retrievable beyond that issue comment: the driver script ran from a base64-embedded payload under /tmp on the trainer, never committed, and wrote no artifact upload).

caveats: Single walk-forward split (one train/test boundary), not multiple folds -- the pre-registered rule is a sign test at one split, not a robustness-across-splits claim.

Effect size is small: +1.3127R over 119 trades is +0.011R/trade, versus the -34.92R (-0.099R/trade) paired delta measured over the full, heavily in-sample window in the w5n reconcile packet. The in-sample estimate was optimistic in direction as well as magnitude on this split.
The twin-dedup bug (PI-20260926-96NDZSOD-0001) is an INDEPENDENT precondition for any re-promotion and is unaffected by this units verdict.

This retrain used only BTCUSDT-derived trades for the OOS test population, but the training ROWS included ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT rows (matching the live artifacts multi-symbol training), consistent with the original artifacts own recipe.
Drift at demote time (ks 0.2018 / psi 0.9637, W4 2026-09-25) is unaffected by this result and still applies to the CURRENT live artifact, which was not retrained.

note: PASS under RULE-RQ0927-001-EXIT-HEAD-OOS-ATTRIBUTION: recovered_R_oos = +1.3127 over n=119 genuinely out-of-sample trades (walk-forward retrain, embargoed 7-day split at 2025-01-06), clearing the pre-registered n>=64 floor. This is directionally positive but a SMALL effect (+0.011R/trade) and a SINGLE split -- read as marginal support for omitted_exit_head, not a decisive result, and it does not by itself license shadow->advisory: PI-20260926-96NDZSOD-0001 (twin-dedup mirror divergence) remains an independent precondition. Supersedes RQ-20260922-007s in-sample-biased +3.7796 cross-population reading and its own full-window paired delta of -34.9179 as the figure to cite for this decision.
